audit: Card.updateReplacementEffects supplies trait/keyword effects and live shield DamageDone/Destroy, stun Untap, finality Moved effects.
CardState.LandTraitChanges supplies planeswalker loyalty, battle defense and saga lore ETB counter replacements; these are Moved effects.
CardFactoryUtil Adventure/Omen/Vengeance replacement builders use Moved, not BeginPhase.

CardState.hasNoAdditionalTraits excludes unknown CardState/Card/KeywordCollection subclasses, nonempty keyword/trait sources and split originals; opaque FSnapshotTable versions and nonnative effective types preserve gathering.
ReplacementHandler retains existing exact-card admission, zone checks, effect applicability and historical/LKI paths.
ReplaceBeginPhase checks ValidPlayer and Phase; PhaseHandler supplies Affected player and Phase. Skip True returns Skipped.
No caches, keyword roles, type/counter replacement paths or event modes besides BeginPhase were changed.
scope: Source inspection plus supplied-board native controls, not an exhaustive proof of all engine or Magic rules.
